g.text: Stereo headphone amp, 9 V battery, single supply, NJM4556A (70 mA out)

g.text: Vref = 9 V x R8 / (R7 + R8) = 4.5 V, C3 47 uF makes it an AC ground

g.desc: Vref = 9 V x R8 / (R7 + R8) = 4.5 V, C3 47 uF makes it an AC ground

g.text: G = 1 + R3 / R4 = 1 + 22k / 10k = 3.2 (+10 dB); C6 gives DC gain 1

g.desc: G = 1 + R3 / R4 = 1 + 22k / 10k = 3.2 (+10 dB); C6 gives DC gain 1

g.text: f_out = 1 / (2 pi RL 1000 uF) = 10 Hz at 16 ohm, 5 Hz at 32 ohm

g.desc: f_out = 1 / (2 pi RL 1000 uF) = 10 Hz at 16 ohm, 5 Hz at 32 ohm

g.text: I_out max 70 mA: 2.2 V pk = 78 mW into 32 ohm, 1.1 V pk = 39 mW into 16 ohm
